caption: The drawing depicts a single, closed, rectangular metal box with rounded edges placed on a flat surface. The box has a hinged lid, as indicated by a visible seam and a small hinge mechanism on its top edge. The coloring of the drawing is primarily rendered in shades of gray for the box, giving it a metallic appearance, while the background consists of warm beige and light brown tones that mimic a wood-grain or marbled effect. The box is centrally positioned and slightly angled so that its front and one side are both visible. The shading is subtle and soft, contributing to the three-dimensional look of the box, and no other objects are present in the composition.
title: Pewter Box
